body:
Part of #289; coordinate #36/#235. Uses the structure audit's reviewed diagnosis. Independent author-task specification and external candidate discovery may start in parallel; implementation/adoption must address that diagnosis.

## Question

Can a reusable interpretation contract absorb ordinary authors' presentation bookkeeping without fixing them to the current model family or erasing dependent witnesses? Treat author requirements, interpretation, model construction and comparisons as interacting responsibilities, not four predetermined modules.

## Acceptance

- Freeze a mathematical fragment and author capability independently of existing `Typed` annotations. Specify context extension, simultaneous substitution, Id/J, the status of object-language Sigma versus contextual packages, and empty substitution. Distinguish conditions on admissible derivations from unconstrained host functions.
- Compare the current route with a representation whose judgment indices do not quantify over the entire current `Model`. Include repair through fixed templates/coherent presentation comparisons as a candidate, and a credible externally sourced replacement. Initial syntax and controlled parametric authoring remain eligible; neither initiality nor parametricity may simply be assumed as the solution.
- State the model maps under which an authored argument must be uniform and establish the relevant preservation discipline. Use a rejection test such as arbitrary classical selection on nonempty carriers failing to commute with Bool symmetry; reuse checked existing evidence where applicable. A term in every model is not by itself a uniformly interpretable derivation.
- Construct interpretation and substitution/equality preservation for the admitted rules. Exercise both substitutions of the frozen transport value and its dependent certificate. Explicitly account for the dependent action on higher identity; report the separate higher-model interpretation as a remaining gate until its concrete evidence exists.
- Build comparisons into the contract: identity/composition, action on types and terms, context extension and J branch compatibility. Compare strict preservation with coherent preservation up to specified isomorphism. Separate changes of presentation from changes of mathematical setting. No caller-supplied record field may merely restate the comparison the experiment is meant to construct.
- Use the already public substituted-versus-fresh command problem as a discriminating case without resuming or claiming completion of #107. Include a case rejecting decoded-equality reflection. Permit changing syntax, equality judgments and semantic organization; eventual adoption must recover the named mathematical capabilities with an explicit migration/retirement plan.
- Check whether settings or signature assignments varying over a context change the proposed boundary. Supply a small indexed case or a precise explicitly owned limitation. Distinguish source interpretation from extraction back to inspectable syntax and state whether either round trip is required by the selected client.
- Publish the ordinary caller's remaining obligations and compare them with the baseline. A smaller spelling of the same casts, or success only in native proof-irrelevant equality, does not establish the intended replacement.

## Evidence and boundaries

Use `docs/research/dependent-architecture-reassessment.md`, its three independent assessments, #292's report and frozen external memo as starting evidence. Consult primary sources for the claims actually used. These are competing diagnoses and proposals, not new checked theorems. The work is scoped by its mathematical questions, not an arbitrary effort cap. Substantial reconstruction or a different foundation is an allowed outcome; an immediate adapter to current generated annotations is not a condition for investigating it.

Keep object-language identity, judgmental equality, metatheoretic equality and presentation comparisons distinct. State which observations an interpretation preserves; a deliberately lossy interpretation is not invalid merely because it is not faithful. Require exact selected data when the client contract calls for it. Separate model-builder work, ordinary author work and host-language encoding cost.

Persist findings, failed approaches, positive constructions, exact hypotheses and the adopt/investigate/defer/reject decision. New Lean claims require checked specializations, statement review and README's applicable build/exhaustive audit. Research and implementation require independent Standards/Spec review. This issue does not resume #107, select or prepare #108's fresh theorem, activate #260, require a new frontend, or authorize weakening the mathematical acceptance conditions.

## Coordination

Implementation is blocked by #314. Candidate discovery and the independent task freeze can proceed in parallel. Coordinate #316 higher semantics and #319 internal setting construction; #317 exercises the admitted constructor extension and #320 owns subsequent independent author observations.
title: Compare dependent judgment representations without universal semantic annotation indices
